# Vendored Markdown libraries

These browser builds run locally and need no CDN request. `essay-markdown.js` sanitizes Marked output with DOMPurify before the app inserts it into the reader.

- Marked 18.0.14, distributed under MIT. The bundled file and license are `marked-18.0.14.umd.js` and `marked-LICENSE.txt`.
- DOMPurify 3.4.16, distributed under Apache-2.0. The bundled file and license are `dompurify-3.4.16.min.js` and `dompurify-LICENSE.txt`.

Upstream sources: [Marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked), [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify).
